numbers.source_quote: 低于当期转股价格的 85%（即 92.56 元/股）
收盘价低于当期转股价格的 85%
初始转股价格为 108.89 元/股
修正前转股价格：7.10 元/股
修正后转股价格：6.42 元/股
本次转股价格调整生效日期：2026 年 8 月 17 日

key_points.point: Opposite directions: Sugon's board, despite the clause being triggered, decided NOT to revise downward - and committed not to propose a revision if re-triggered between 2026-08-14 and 2026-11-13; Guizhou Gas DID revise downward, from 7.10 to 6.42 yuan/share, effective 2026-08-17

Sugon's trigger: closing price below 85% of the prevailing conversion price (92.56 yuan/share) on at least 15 of any 30 consecutive trading days; the threshold derives from the 108.89 initial conversion price × 85% (~92.56, derived check)
Sugon's next trigger window restarts on 2026-11-14 (rolled forward if not a trading day), when the board will meet again to decide
Guizhou Gas suspension: conversion suspended for the full day 2026-08-14, resuming 2026-08-17 under the revised price; this revision is roughly a 9.58% cut (derived)
Guizhou Gas's conversion price went through TWO kinds of adjustments: an active downward revision (10.17→7.22) and passive dividend-driven adjustments (7.22→7.18→7.15→…→7.10) - different mechanisms

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 公司董事会决定本次不向下修正转股价格
低于当期转股价格的 85%（即 92.56 元/股）
修正后转股价格：6.42 元/股

notes: Same mechanism, opposite decisions - swapping WHICH company revised is the gravest direction error (K1 plus source_file both guard it); Sugon's three-month pledge is a commitment, not an executed revision. The 92.56 threshold must reconcile with 108.89 × 85% (derived N4). Conflating active revisions with dividend-driven passive adjustments fails K5. The two bonds' names/codes are near-collisions (113708 vs 110084); citing to the wrong file loses citation points. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
